data.name: Putriya
data.gender_notes: Putriya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word Putri, meaning 'daughter' or 'princess'. In Islamic culture, this name is often given to a baby girl as a sign of her royal status as a child of God. The name Putriya carries the meaning “Little Princess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Indonesian. Parents who choose Putriya usually hope their child will grow to embody little princess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual connection between a child and their divine parent, emphasizing their worth and dignity as a human being.
data.etymology: Putriya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Princess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Putriya total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
